DeployBot: kickoff: migration 2029-12-02T03:00Z -> users.settings ADD COLUMN preferred_locale text DEFAULT 'en-US' USING ('en-US') WITH ONLINE REWRITE. change window 03:00-04:00 UTC. canary order: alpha -> gamma. holdpoints between shards.

James: rolling rewrite hit a blocking lock on gamma-replica-2, progress paused :alarm_clock:

Linh: pg_stat_activity shows pid 48721 holding a heavyweight lock, query: "COPY analytics_events FROM stdin ..." state=active, age ~ 18m

Sam: that COPY is our nightly event ingest, shouldn't be running in window. Could be an adhoc resume. Killing may abort a large COPY and force re-ingest.

DB-Ops: proposal: 1) attempt to notify owner via pg_notify and slack 2) pg_cancel_backend 3) if still active after 3m, escalate to pg_terminate_backend 4) if terminate used, run quick consistency check on users.settings row counts and resume with phased backfill.

Paul: agree. also add a safety to never terminate pids from role 'billing_writer' or 'payments_job'

Release Manager: holdpoint enforced: do NOT advance to delta shards until gamma clears and we've run the 3-minute observation window post-action. If any client-visible errors appear, execute rollback plan RM-rollback-1.

Oncall: enabling tracing for settings endpoints and subscribing to alerts; will set temporary traffic shift to canary at 10% while we observe

James: pinging analytics @paul to check if someone kicked off a manual import

Paul: confirmed no manual import. this is a stray resume from yesterday's failed job. OK to evict once tracing and alerts are in place.

Linh: executing notify -> cancel -> terminate sequence. first: `SELECT pg_notify('deploy_migration', 'pid=48721,action=cancel');` then `SELECT pg_cancel_backend(48721);`

Linh: pg_cancel_backend returned false; issuing `SELECT pg_terminate_backend(48721);` :boom:

Linh: terminated pid 48721. lock released. observed ~0 rows committed by that session.

DeployBot: detected lock release, resuming rewrite on gamma after 45s grace window.

Sam: small change to rollout: instead of full rewrite on remaining shards, switch to phased backfill job that updates rows in batches (100k) to avoid heavy table locks; will run as background migration and mark migration as hybrid (immediate schema with background population).

DB-Ops: prepared backfill runner and health-check SQLs. sample check:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM users.settings WHERE preferred_locale IS NULL;
SELECT count(*) FROM users.settings WHERE preferred_locale = 'en-US';
```

Release Manager: decision: proceed with hybrid approach. pin runtime-sdk to 3.1.0 for this release until downstream clients validate locale handling. Add note in release notes about background backfill and potential slight lag for older rows.

Oncall: monitoring 5xx and latency. alert threshold set to 0.75% 5xx or +15% p95 latency for 10m will trigger rollback.

James: applied immediate schema change to alpha and gamma; background job started against remaining shards. no constraint violations so far.

Paul: drafted release notes blurb: "Added preferred_locale (default en-US). Switched to background backfill due to a blocking ingest job on gamma; no client-facing errors observed. Pinned SDK to 3.1.0 for compatibility checks."

DB-Ops: saved hybrid migration helper script to /ops/migrations/hybrid_backfill_preferred_locale.sh and opened PR https://git.redwood/proj/ops/migrations/pull/21 :thumbsup:

DeployBot: migration hybrid-20291202-pref-locale recorded as partial-atomic; background backfill job id=bgf-20291202-07; final status: in_progress -> will close when bg job reaches 0 nulls or after 7 days.

Release Manager: created follow-up ticket PROJ-3402 to add long-running COPY detection and auto-gate during rewrite windows.

Oncall: posted termination audit and the notify logs to #incidents for compliance.

James: thanks team. lesson learned: prefer hybrid by default when ingestion windows overlap. updating runbook with gating checks and whitelist roles :memo:

Linh: closing thread, will annotate migration entry with evict details and grace window used.

DeployBot: automated entry: migration hybrid-20291202-pref-locale flagged hybrid, pinned-runtime=3.1.0, followup=PROJ-3402
